name: seedlayer
description: Configure a project once and generate the app scaffold plus the AI context layer.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @seedlayer/core build && pnpm --filter @seedlayer/packs build && pnpm --filter @seedlayer/web dev
scripts.generate:example: pnpm --filter @seedlayer/core build && pnpm --filter @seedlayer/packs build && pnpm --filter create-seedlayer build && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js examples/startup-speed --preset startup-speed --skip-install --force
